_about: Louise Seymour Houghton's The Russian Grandmother's Wonder Tales (undated in the text), South Slavonic tales which her preface says she took from Friedrich Krauss's German collection and set in a frame of village life. Gutenberg catalogue: Houghton 1838-1920, Krauss 1859-1938. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-10: Adam asked the project to keep going until he stops it; Adam may veto).
